rationale: Record teaching the macOS and Windows plug-in hosts to consult the generalized overlay slot on a press, which only the standalone and web hosts did, so a popover claimed by @pulp/react's overlay prop or by an imported design stayed open forever on an outside click inside a DAW editor. The decision moves into a route_press_to_active_overlay verb in pointer dispatch so it is testable headlessly, and a wiring gate fences it to the existing ComboBox dismissal so a host cannot wire one without the other. Watch-only: no design-import or rendering authority is transferred, and no imported node kind, asset path, or render backend changes behavior.
